mode: Nine consistent main-character portraits derived from the existing Whale-girl identity; separate from full-body desktop-pet animations.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Asset type: WELCOME portrait of Whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) for the main character in Umeko Desktop. Image 1 is her existing MAIN-PAGE RARE PORTRAIT: primary identity, big-head chibi proportions and clean anime illustration style reference. Image 2 is her existing desktop pet: supporting canonical costume/whale-emblem reference ONLY, do not copy the full-body layout.
Create a single WAIST-UP portrait WITH BOTH HANDS fully visible, ending at waist. Preserve giant cute head and small torso, long wavy deep-blue hair fading lighter blue, curled ahoge, blue eyes, white lace maid headdress, small bright-blue side bow with gold center and white wing-like cloth trim, navy/white maid dress, frilled cuffs and a small blue whale emblem on the apron. Refine the linework to read clearly at a 210px homepage size, moderate restrained cel-shaded highlights, consistent with image1.
Pose: one hand cradles a simple small white bowl of cooked white rice at upper abdomen; the other relaxed open palm reaches slightly forward as if quietly asking the human to give rice. Calm half-lidded expectant gaze, tiny closed mouth, a slightly entitled and endearing deadpan expression, not an angry pout, not a huge cheerful grin, no crying. The dialogue is '人，你来了。米呢。' but DO NOT draw any text.
Framing: centered complete head/hair/headdress plus both forearms/hands/rice bowl, generous 7% genuinely TRANSPARENT margin on TOP and both SIDES, no cropping across hair or fingers. Square canvas. No legs, scenery, floor, shadows, floating ornaments, decorative stars, letters, speech bubbles, logo or watermark. Accurate anatomy: two arms, each hand one thumb and four fingers with natural occlusion. Only the isolated character and the held rice bowl.
